title: Create: Extra Recipes

body:
## Create: Extra Recipes

**Inspired by Create: Additional Recipes**

This datapack adds convenient material conversion recipes to the Create mod, allowing you to transform common resources into more valuable materials using standard Create machinery.

### Features:
- **Charcoal to Coal**: Compact 4 charcoal into 1 coal using a Basin and Mechanical Press
- **Coal Block to Diamond**: Transform coal blocks into diamonds using a superheated Basin and Mechanical Press

Perfect for automating resource production and reducing inventory clutter. All recipes use vanilla Create mechanics—no additional mods required!

The features added is part of **Create: Additional Recipes**. I just ported some of the features from there so my diamond farm would work!

**Compatible with:** Minecraft 1.21.1 + Create (NeoForge/Forge)
